node: Nuclear fuel cycle, HALEU enrichment, and regulated baseload supply for data-center power
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a narrow public-market universe around the nuclear fuel-cycle and regulated-baseload chokepoint. The strongest direct exposure is still Centrus Energy because HALEU enrichment is a core bottleneck for many advanced reactors. The underfollowed discovery lane adds Silex Systems via its OTCQX listing and majority ownership of Global Laser Enrichment, plus less-obvious component and execution bottleneck names Flowserve and Fluor. These are not recommendations; they are research candidates requiring verification of backlog, customer contracts, NRC milestones, and revenue sensitivity to nuclear/data-center demand.
